title: Young players today, the Royal Garden and Armstrong at the piano
summary: Phillips dislikes modern bands that sing, recalls Royal Garden with Jack Carey and mutes, and Mrs. Phillips remembers Armstrong playing piano.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

Did they use many mute to note bands like Jack Carrier's band when you worked with them?

They sometimes. Just sometimes. Sometimes. Jack used to care of mute all the time. And sometimes we had to tell him about it. Sometimes he used to get mad with me too. I said, what you care for? Well, he'd get to play sometime. I said, you could leave that mute home.

I know, that's one thing Mutt used to feature when he left here. That's right. He used to feature all different kind of mutes. And the same thing is true of Oliver. I just wondered if they used mutes, Danny.
Did Oliver use mutes much here? I think he did. He played so much. Oh Lord.
